info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Market Operation By Param1-spec
info.description: The Corporate Action Market Operations API enables users to access detailed information about market operations related to corporate actions based on specific parameters. This API facilitates the retrieval of comprehensive data needed for financial analysis and reporting. Typical consumers include financial analysts, investment managers, and regulatory bodies who require accurate corporate action details for decision-making. By utilizing this endpoint, users can effectively track and manage corporate activity impacting market operations.

get.summary: Retrieve corporate action details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information regarding a specific corporate action by providing its unique identifier. The returned data will include all relevant attributes associated with the corporate action, enabling you to understand its implications and specifics.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the corporate action details.
